notes.title: Pitiri 1977: FREE Soundtrack Update
notes.content:
Get the FREE Soundtrack with your copy of Pitiri 1977!
Just look in your game folder.
You will also get the Cover & Box Art of course!

All Songs written & recorded by Jürgen Brunner / ILIKESCIFI Games

notes.title: Pitiri 1977 - 10 year anniversary
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=NCCdqBvcGZo;full][/previewyoutube]

10 YEARS DEVELOPMENT ANIVERSARY!
Comments & insights by Jürgen Brunner - ILIKESCIFI Games
All the things you always wanted to know about the game, the development of Pitiri 1977, our team and the fact that 10 years ago everything started!
I can´t believe that 10 years ago we presented our prototype of Pitiri 1977 to the world! 10 years dudes! Makes me feel like an indie veteran somehow.

- PITIRI 1977 CREDITS -

Jürgen Brunner
Dominik Gröstlinger
David Philipp
Hannes Drexl
Johannes Figlhuber

Special thx to everyone who supported this project as well!!!

notes.title: Major Update (v2.2)
notes.content:
We have fixed a bunch of issues:

- Extras: Windowed & Fullscreen Mode
- Game: Faster texts
- Game: Energy bar recovers faster
- Game: Sandbox minor changes
- A ton of bugs fixxed
- Speed & framerate issues
- Soundtrack: tagged, smaller, better quality ( ...Steam\steamapps\common\Pitiri1977)
